title: Size bound after fanout reduction
statement: Let $C$ be a finite directed acyclic Boolean circuit, and suppose each gate reads distinct input vertices, with exactly one input for a NOT gate and exactly two for an AND or OR gate. The size of the circuit obtained by the fanout reduction construction is at most $n+5m$, where $n$ is the number of input vertices and $m$ is the number of gates of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit with n input vertices
Every gate of C has distinct arguments and exactly one argument for NOT gates or two for AND/OR gates
